title: Publish cycle only (after manual portal edits)
summary: For edits made directly in Toast Web by staff: the gate sequence that makes changes real, with verification.

steps.title: Save each edited record
steps.instructions: Every editor must show "Saved" before publishing — saves stage changes at the account level.

steps.title: Publish all changes
steps.instructions: Menus > Publish all changes. Wait for the POS tiles to confirm the new revision.

steps.title: Confirm on a terminal
steps.instructions: Add the edited item to a test check, cancel the check, verify name/price/modifiers and the printed ticket.
